description: This Java source file defines the class SagePayServices, providing methods to handle various SagePay payment operations such as payment authentication, authorization, release, void, and refund. It interacts with the SagePay API, manages request and response data, and handles different payment transaction states.

classes.name: SagePayServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling SagePay payment transactions such as authentication, authorization, release, void, and refund, integrating with the SagePay API and managing response handling.

methods.name: buildSagePayProperties
methods.description: Builds and returns a map of SagePay configuration properties from the given context and delegator, fetching data from the entity store based on paymentGatewayConfigId.

methods.name: paymentAuthentication
methods.description: Initiates a payment authentication request to SagePay with provided card and billing details, returning the response data and status.

methods.name: paymentAuthorisation
methods.description: Completes a payment authorization (capture) request to SagePay using transaction identifiers and amount, returning the response data and status.

methods.name: paymentRelease
methods.description: Releases (captures) a pre-authorized payment in SagePay, returning the response data and status.

methods.name: paymentVoid
methods.description: Voids a payment transaction in SagePay, returning the response data and status.

methods.name: paymentRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a SagePay transaction, returning the response data and status.
